items: What was the name of the Prophet's father, who died before he was born?
The Prophet's father was Abdullah ibn Abdul-Muttalib, who died in Medina before the Prophet's birth.
Who cared for the Prophet after his mother died, until he was eight years old?
After the death of his mother Aminah, the Prophet was taken in by his grandfather Abdul-Muttalib.
Which uncle took the Prophet into his home and protected him after his grandfather's death?
Abu Talib raised and protected the Prophet until his own death.
Who was the Prophet's foster mother, with whom he spent his early childhood?
Halimah as-Sa'diyyah nursed the Prophet and he lived with her tribe for the first years.
What title did the people of Mecca give the Prophet in his youth because of his honesty?
Who comforted the Prophet after the first revelation and was the first to believe in him?
Khadijah was the first to believe in the Prophet.
Which of the Prophet's daughters continued his lineage through Hasan and Husayn?
Fatimah was the mother of Hasan and Husayn.
Who was the first muezzin of Islam?
The Prophet's muezzin Bilal gave the first call to prayer.
Who accompanied the Prophet on the Hijrah from Mecca to Medina?
Abu Bakr was the Prophet's companion on the Hijrah.
In which cave did the Prophet and Abu Bakr hide for three days during the Hijrah?
They sheltered in the Cave of Thawr to escape the Quraysh.
What are the Muslims who left their homes and property in Mecca for Medina called?
Those who migrated from Mecca are the Muhajirun.
What are the Muslims of Medina who hosted and shared everything with the migrants called?
The people of Medina who supported the migrants are the Ansar (helpers).
Which was the first mosque the Prophet helped build on his way to Medina?
The Prophet took part in building the Quba Mosque.
Which mosque did the Prophet build after reaching Medina, serving as the centre of the community?
Masjid an-Nabawi was the centre of the new Muslim community.
Which uncle of the Prophet, known as the 'Lion of God', was martyred at Uhud?
Hamzah ibn Abdul-Muttalib was martyred at Uhud.
At what age did the Prophet pass away in Medina?
The Prophet passed away at the age of 63 in the 11th year after the Hijrah.
What is the area between the Prophet's grave and his pulpit in Medina called?
The area between his house and his pulpit is called the Rawdah (garden of Paradise).
What is the Prophet's famous address at Arafat, a few months before his death, called?
The Farewell Sermon was given during the Farewell Pilgrimage.
To which great Arab tribe of Mecca did the Prophet belong?
The Prophet belonged to the Quraysh.
To which clan of the Quraysh did the Prophet belong?
The Prophet belonged to the clan of Banu Hashim.
Which pact for protecting the wronged did the Prophet join in his youth?
Hilf al-Fudul was a pledge to uphold justice and protect the wronged.
Which house in Mecca did the early Muslims use as a secret gathering place?
Dar al-Arqam was where the first Muslims gathered and learned.
To which land did the persecuted Muslims make their first migration, with the Prophet's permission?
The first migration was to Abyssinia.
What is the year in which the Prophet lost both Khadijah and Abu Talib called?
Both died in the tenth year of the prophethood: the Year of Sorrow.
Who suggested digging a trench around Medina at the Battle of the Trench?
What are the pledges of allegiance made by the people of Medina to the Prophet before the Hijrah called?
The Pledges of Aqabah paved the way for the Hijrah.
Which treaty in the 6th year after the Hijrah gave a ten-year peace and opened the way to the conquest of Mecca?
The Treaty of Hudaybiyah led to peace and later to the conquest of Mecca.
Which pledge was given under a tree after the news that Uthman had been killed at Hudaybiyah?
The Pledge of Ridwan was given beneath the tree at Hudaybiyah.
What was the brotherhood between the Muhajirun and the Ansar in Medina called?
The Prophet paired migrants and helpers as brothers.
What was the covered area at the back of the Prophet's Mosque where homeless companions studied called?
The People of the Suffah lived and studied there.
What are military expeditions the Prophet personally led called?
Expeditions led personally by the Prophet are called ghazwah.
What are military expeditions the Prophet sent under another commander called?
Expeditions led by a commander he appointed are called sariyyah.
In which battle in the 3rd year after the Hijrah was Hamzah martyred?
Hamzah was martyred in the Battle of Uhud.
With whom did the Prophet stay for about seven months until his house was completed in Medina?
Abu Ayyub al-Ansari hosted the Prophet in Medina.
Whom did the Prophet appoint to lead the prayer during his final illness?
Abu Bakr led the prayers in the Prophet's last illness.
Which commander received the title 'Sword of God' from the Prophet and saved the army at Mu'tah?
Khalid ibn al-Walid took command and withdrew the army at Mu'tah.
In which year after the Hijrah was Mecca conquered?
The conquest of Mecca took place in the 8th year after the Hijrah.
Which mosque is where the qiblah changed from Jerusalem to the Kaaba during prayer?
At Masjid al-Qiblatayn the prayer direction was changed.
What is the first written constitution agreed on in Medina between Muslims, Jews and other tribes called?
The Constitution of Medina set out rights and duties of the communities.
To which sacred mosque was the Prophet taken on the Night Journey (Isra)?
On the Night Journey the Prophet travelled to Al-Aqsa.
In which battle against the Byzantines were Zayd ibn Harithah, Ja'far ibn Abi Talib and Abdullah ibn Rawahah martyred in succession?
All three commanders fell in turn at Mu'tah.
Which was the last expedition the Prophet led in person, at a time of heat and drought, against a Byzantine threat?
Tabuk was the last expedition the Prophet led.
Who was given the banner at Khaybar and is known for conquering the fortress of Qamus?
Ali ibn Abi Talib conquered Qamus.
Which battle, soon after the conquest of Mecca, did the Muslims first falter in due to relying on their numbers?
At Hunayn the Muslims were at first shaken by overconfidence in their numbers.
Who was the young commander appointed by the Prophet to lead an army that Abu Bakr later sent out?
Usamah ibn Zayd led the army the Prophet had prepared.
Which companion was sent as the first teacher to Medina after the first pledge of Aqabah?
Mus'ab ibn Umayr taught Islam to the people of Medina.
Which Jewish tribe of Medina broke its treaty and sided with the Quraysh during the Battle of the Trench?
Banu Qurayzah broke the treaty during the Trench.
Which mosque did the hypocrites build to harm the Quba Mosque and cause division, and which the Prophet had destroyed?
Masjid ad-Dirar was built to cause harm and division.
Which expedition did the wounded Muslim army undertake the day after Uhud to pursue the Quraysh?
The pursuit after Uhud is known as the expedition of Hamra' al-Asad.
